svg.text: PCA: find the direction cells spread out the most, then the next
PC1 runs along the long axis of the cloud;
PC2 is perpendicular and captures almost nothing
B Same cells, rotated onto the PCs
Keep PC1, drop PC2: one number per cell
now separates monocytes from T cells
a flat floor of noise to the right
In real data the 'cloud' lives in 2,000 dimensions and we keep 20–40 PCs instead of one, but the idea is identical: each PC is a direction; a cell's
score is how far along that direction it sits.
